privileged_info_for_vlm: The OpenBCI GUI version is v5.2.2. In this version, the Impedance widget is used to monitor electrode contact. For a 'SYNTHETIC' session, the agent must select 'SYNTHETIC' in the initial system control panel before clicking 'Start Session'. Channels 1 and 2 are considered 'Frontal' in standard 10-20 setups (Fp1/Fp2). The screenshot must be saved specifically to /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/impedance_check.png.
